verdict.rationale: stagewise documents multiple agent instances running in parallel, each with its own chat session and optionally a different model, so the same task could be tried with different agents. Per-edit diff review, accept/reject and undo provide a way to inspect and discard changes. However, nothing shows these parallel runs are isolated attempts at the same task, or that they can be compared side by side with one picked as the winner. Missing for 10: isolated per-attempt workspaces (e.g., worktrees/branches), side-by-side comparison of competing attempts, a select-one-and-discard-others workflow, independent corroboration.
